children: MetaVia reported preclinical DA-1726 data showing highest tissue exposure in adipose tissue and prolonged retention consistent with once-weekly dosing.
Preclinical tissue distribution study found DA-1726-derived radioactivity is slowly absorbed and extensively distributed throughout the body.
Highest tissue exposure observed in adipose tissue, with greatest off-site exposure in abdominal, subcutaneous and brown fat, and liver.
Tissue-to-plasma ratios increased over time, indicating prolonged retention in tissues through the final 144-hour assessment.
Findings are consistent with a prolonged pharmacokinetic profile supporting once-weekly subcutaneous dosing of DA-1726.
Only minimal radioactivity detected in the central nervous system, aligning with limited brain penetration typical of peptide therapies.
